title: Revoke, disable, removal and update while a task runs

steps.when: the user revokes run_reviewed_tool_tasks, disables or removes the Plugin
steps.then: under P11's recommendation the task runs to its end under the Host, stays in the Status Item with Stop, and nothing is delivered to the Plugin; the alternative stops it as scenario 04

steps.when: the Plugin is updated with the same Capability scope
steps.then: the updated Plugin's activities.list still finds the task; a changed scope drops delivery as revocation does

steps.when: the task completes after its owner ended
steps.then: the late completion updates only the Host's own entry
